app_fee.value: CAD 135 per application, non-refundable; some programs add a supplementary fee.
app_fee.quote: There is a CDN $135 application fee. This fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. A supplementary application fee may be assessed depending upon the program

fee_waiver.value: The School of Graduate Studies does not waive the application fee; a few departments run small equity waivers, mostly for domestic applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no refund, waiver, or deferral of the application fee.

gre_general.value: Set by each graduate unit; most do not require the GRE. See the program record.
gre_general.quote: Although most of our graduate units do not require a GRE exam, there are some that do.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 93 overall with 22 in writing and speaking (4.5 on the new 1-6 scale); tests must be within 24 months.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum required score: 7.0 (Academic) with at least 6.5 for each component.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the exempt-country list, but you are normally exempt if your whole degree was taught and examined in English; departments usually want an official letter or transcript notation confirming this, and a unit can still ask for a test.
english_waiver.quote: Normally, if applicants meet any one of the following conditions, they are not required to submit proof of proficiency in English (please consult the graduate unit to determine whether proof of English-language proficiency will still be required) | Has obtained their admitting degree from an institution recognized by the University of Toronto and where the language of instruction and examination is uniformly English

also.quote: An official letter from the university confirming English instruction and examination will be required, unless there is an appropriate notation on the transcript.

notes: Applications go through SGS GradApp; deadlines, GRE and supervisor rules are set by each department.
